doc_kind: Medicaid policy (UnitedHealthcare Community Plan, Ohio) delegating criteria to InterQual
lines_of_business: UnitedHealthcare Community Plan (Medicaid), Ohio only: 'This Medical Policy only applies to the state of Ohio.'
effective_or_revised: Text shows Policy CS007OH.E effective July 1, 2026 (library metadata labels the file CS007OH.D / 05/01/2025; the PDF says it archived version D)
sections_in_order: Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
criteria_location: There are no clinical criteria in the document. Coverage Rationale (p.1) says 'For medical necessity clinical coverage criteria, refer to the InterQual CP: Procedures: Bariatric or Metabolic Surgery' (adult and adolescent) and lists only unproven procedures.
procedures_covered: Bariatric or Metabolic Surgery (adult and adolescent; via InterQual)

Unproven: bariatric artery embolization, gastric electrical stimulation, laparoscopic greater curvature plication, mini/OAGB, Silastic ring vertical gastric bypass, SADI-S, transoral endoscopic surgery (ESG, liners, balloon, TORe, TransPyloric Shuttle), VBLOC

logic.top_level: other (delegated to InterQual; the document itself contains only a NOT list of unproven procedures)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Bulleted list of unproven procedures, plus 'Bariatric surgery as the primary treatment for any condition other than obesity'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: None in policy; Definitions define Conversion, Corrective, Reversal for revisional surgery but set no criteria (InterQual presumably).
